privacy_policy.meta_description: How Doctoory collects, uses, and protects personal and health data across our website, mobile app, and services in Egypt and GCC markets.
privacy_policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_policy.subtitle: (for Digital Medical Platform: Website & Mobile App)
privacy_policy.intro_who_text: Doctoory, a healthcare/medical services and retail platform operating in Egypt and selected Gulf Cooperation Council ("GCC") markets, including (as applicable) the UAE, KSA, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman and Kuwait.
privacy_policy.intro_services_text: (a) sale of medical products and equipment (B2C/B2B), (b) online medical consultations (telehealth), and (c) home-outreach healthcare visits.
privacy_policy.intro_li_complaints_detail: see "Your Rights & Contacts by Country" below.
privacy_policy.intro_agreement: By using our Website/App/Services, you agree to this Privacy Policy and our Terms of Use.
privacy_policy.s01_intro: We collect <pd>Personal Data</pd> and <hd>Health Data</hd> you provide or that we generate when delivering care and ecommerce:
privacy_policy.s01_li_account: Account & identity: name, date of birth, national ID/passport (where legally required for care), photos/avatars, login credentials, language.
privacy_policy.s01_li_transactional: Transactional: orders, invoices, delivery status, returns, warranty/recall history.
privacy_policy.s01_li_medical: Medical/health (special category): symptoms, history, medications/allergies, referrals, physician notes, diagnostic files (e.g., images, labs), consultation recordings/notes (if applicable), triage outcomes, care plans, home-visit observations, assistive-device measurements/fittings.
privacy_policy.s01_li_telehealth: Telehealth & device data: call/consult metadata, device/app diagnostics, optional wearable data you connect.
privacy_policy.s01_li_location: Location: approximate geolocation (for dispatch/visit routing) and optional precise location (if you enable it).
privacy_policy.s01_li_payment: Payment: masked payment tokens and outcomes (we don't store raw card data; processors are PCI-DSS compliant).
privacy_policy.s01_li_technical: Technical/usage: cookies/SDKs, IP, device type, app version, crash logs.
privacy_policy.s01_footer: We do <no>not</no> sell your personal data.
privacy_policy.s02_title: 2) Why we process your data (purposes & legal bases)
privacy_policy.s02_li_care: Provide care and services: triage, schedule, treat, deliver/maintain medical equipment; legal basis: contract, consent, and/or vital interests; for health data, explicit consent or other healthcare exemptions as allowed by local laws (e.g., PDPL Egypt, PDPL KSA, PDPL UAE).
privacy_policy.s02_li_ecommerce: Operate ecommerce: orders, payments, delivery, returns; basis: contract, legitimate interests, legal obligation.
privacy_policy.s02_li_quality: Quality & safety: clinical audit, pharmacovigilance/UDI tracking, device recalls; legal obligation/public interest (where applicable).
privacy_policy.s02_li_security: Security & fraud: identity verification, abuse prevention, cybersecurity; legitimate interests/legal obligation.
privacy_policy.s02_li_improvement: Improvement & analytics: de-identified aggregates to improve pathways and supply planning; legitimate interests; for health data we anonymize/pseudonymize where feasible.
privacy_policy.s02_li_marketing: Marketing: only with your opt-in; you can withdraw any time from Settings or unsubscribe link.
privacy_policy.s03_body: Our services are for adults. For minors (or where consent capacity is limited), we obtain consent from a parent/guardian or as permitted by local health-care laws.
privacy_policy.s04_body: We use strictly necessary cookies/SDKs (login, basket, security), functional analytics (to improve reliability), and optional marketing tags (only with consent, where required). You can manage preferences in Settings → Privacy and device OS settings.
privacy_policy.s05_li_recordings: Recordings: Consultations are not recorded unless you give explicit consent or where required for quality/safety or legal defense; we'll display a clear in-app notice if recording is on.
privacy_policy.s05_li_emergency: Emergency use: In emergencies we may process/share health information to protect your vital interests or public health as allowed by local law.
privacy_policy.s05_li_messaging: Clinical messaging: Messages/photos you send to clinicians become part of your medical record (retained per health-record retention rules).
privacy_policy.s06_body: Payments are handled by vetted PCI-DSS processors. We store only tokens/identifiers and reconciliation data. In the UAE, financial sector rules may also apply (e.g., Central Bank Retail Services rules on retention/breach).
privacy_policy.s07_li_providers: Care providers & dispatch partners: physicians, nurses, therapists, labs, radiology centers, and home-visit teams involved in your care.
privacy_policy.s07_li_vendors: Vendors/processors: hosting, cloud, analytics (de-identified where possible), customer support, identity verification, logistics and payment gateways—bound by contracts and processing only under our instructions.
privacy_policy.s07_li_insurers: Insurers/TPAs (if you use insurance): claim processing/authorizations.
privacy_policy.s07_li_regulators: Regulators & law enforcement: where required by law or to protect rights/safety.
privacy_policy.s07_li_transfers: Business transfers: in M&A/restructuring, your data may transfer subject to this Policy.
privacy_policy.s07_footer: We do <no>not</no> permit third parties to use your health data for their own marketing.
privacy_policy.s08_intro: We operate a regional architecture with country-specific controls. Cross-border transfers follow adequacy/consent/contractual safeguards and local health-data localization rules:
privacy_policy.s08_li_uae: UAE: ICT in Health Fields Law (Federal Law No. 2/2019) generally prohibits storing/processing/transferring health data outside the UAE unless approved by the Health Authority + MoHAP; limited exemptions exist via resolutions (e.g., for insurance, research). We maintain UAE-resident hosting for UAE patient health data and seek approvals for permitted transfers.
privacy_policy.s08_li_ksa: KSA (Saudi Arabia): PDPL and guidance restrict cross-border transfers and increasingly require localization for sensitive/PII; transfers follow SDAIA rules and permitted mechanisms. We host Saudi patient data in KSA and use approved transfer tools when needed.
privacy_policy.s08_li_egypt: Egypt: PDPL No. 151/2020 restricts foreign transfers unless the destination offers adequate protection or other legal grounds are met; we prioritize Egypt-resident hosting for Egyptian patient data and use PDPC-recognized transfer bases.
privacy_policy.s08_li_qbo: Qatar, Bahrain, Oman: Each has a general PDPL (Qatar Law 13/2016; Bahrain Law 30/2018; Oman RD 6/2022). We assess adequacy and apply contracts/consents or local hosting where required.
privacy_policy.s08_li_kuwait: Kuwait: No comprehensive PDPL yet (sectoral rules apply). We still apply GDPR-style safeguards and minimize cross-border flows.
privacy_policy.s09_body: We implement administrative, technical and physical controls appropriate to medical data: encryption in transit/at rest, access control with least privilege, MFA for staff, network segregation, audit logging, continuous monitoring, vendor due diligence, and secure SDLC. No system is 100% secure; we continually improve our controls.
privacy_policy.s10_li_medical: Medical records: kept per national health-record retention rules or professional guidance in each country (and longer if required for legal defense).
privacy_policy.s10_li_ecommerce: Ecommerce & finance: invoices/tax records retained per statutory periods.
privacy_policy.s10_li_marketing_support: Marketing & support: retained until you withdraw consent or after inactivity thresholds we apply to minimize data.
privacy_policy.s11_title: 11) Your rights & how to exercise them
privacy_policy.s11_intro: We honor applicable rights under Egyptian and GCC laws (subject to legal/clinical limitations):
privacy_policy.s11_li_rights: Access, portability, correction, deletion (where applicable), restriction, objection, withdrawal of consent, and complaint to the relevant authority.
privacy_policy.s11_li_sensitive: Sensitive/health data: additional protections; we may need to keep certain records for patient safety/legal obligations even if you request deletion.
privacy_policy.s11_li_reg_egypt: Egypt: Personal Data Protection Center (PDPC/"the Centre") under MCIT.
privacy_policy.s11_li_reg_uae: UAE: UAE Data Office (PDPL) and MoHAP/Health Authorities for Health Data Law matters.
privacy_policy.s11_li_reg_ksa: Saudi Arabia: Saudi Data & AI Authority (SDAIA).
privacy_policy.s11_exercise_rights: To exercise rights: Settings → Privacy, or email the DPO: <dpo>[DPO email]</dpo>. We may need to verify your identity and (for medical data) consult treating clinicians before actioning.
privacy_policy.s12_body: If a personal-data breach occurs, we assess impact and notify regulators and affected individuals as required. Current frameworks typically require notification to the regulator within ~72 hours in Egypt and KSA; UAE timeframes depend on implementing regulations and sectoral rules. We will also notify you without undue delay if a breach is likely to harm you.
privacy_policy.s13_body: If you access our Services from the EEA/UK or UAE free-zones (DIFC/ADGM), we apply comparable principles (lawfulness, fairness, transparency, purpose limitation, data minimization, accuracy, storage limitation, integrity/confidentiality, accountability) and use SCCs or equivalent safeguards for transfers.
privacy_policy.s14_body: We do <no>not</no> use fully automated decision-making that produces legal or similarly significant effects in clinical eligibility. We may use risk scoring (e.g., fraud/risk flags) or triage aids; a clinician or human reviewer remains in the loop for medical decisions. You can request <rev>human review</rev> of significant automated assessments where your local law grants that right.
privacy_policy.s15_body: Marketing is opt-in where required. You may withdraw consent via Settings or the unsubscribe link in messages. Withdrawing marketing consent does not affect clinical or delivery communications.
privacy_policy.s16_body: Our Website/App may contain links to third-party services (labs, pharmacies, logistics, payment gateways). Their privacy practices apply; please review their policies before use.
privacy_policy.s17_body: We may update this Policy. If changes are material, we will notify you in-app or by email at least 30 days before they take effect. Continued use after the effective date constitutes acceptance.
privacy_policy.s18_egypt_li1: DPO appointment and (when in force) registration with the PDPC.
privacy_policy.s18_egypt_li2: International transfers only to jurisdictions with adequate protection or under PDPC-approved mechanisms.
privacy_policy.s18_egypt_li3: Breach: notify the PDPC within 72 hours; notify affected individuals within 3 days thereafter (or immediately for national security concerns).
privacy_policy.s18_uae_li1: Health data must remain in the UAE unless an approved exception applies (ICT Health Law).
privacy_policy.s18_uae_li2: PDPL establishes general personal-data principles/rights; the UAE Data Office oversees PDPL matters; sector regulators may impose additional rules (e.g., Central Bank for payment data).
privacy_policy.s18_ksa_li1: PDPL governs processing and cross-border transfers; SDAIA is the competent regulator; localization increasingly enforced for sensitive/PII; breach: notify SDAIA within 72 hours and affected data subjects without undue delay if risk of harm.
privacy_policy.s18_qbo_li1: Each imposes controller/processor duties, data-subject rights, and transfer conditions; we apply local hosting where required and adequate safeguards for any transfers.
privacy_policy.s18_kw_li1: No omnibus PDPL; we apply contractual/consent safeguards and sectoral requirements (e.g., telecom/CITRA DPPR for relevant services).
privacy_policy.s19_li_egypt: Egypt PDPC complaint: see regulator details above.
privacy_policy.s19_li_uae: UAE Data Office queries: see UAE Data Office resources.
privacy_policy.s20_notes_body: This policy's legal hooks map to: Egypt PDPL No. 151/2020, UAE PDPL (Decree-Law 45/2021) plus the UAE Health Data Law (Federal Law 2/2019, Article 13) for strict health-data localization, and Saudi PDPL with 72-hour breach notification and transfer/localization guidance; plus general GCC PDPLs (Qatar 13/2016; Bahrain 30/2018; Oman RD 6/2022) and Kuwait's sectoral regime.
